title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.4 - Custom Server Discord RPC Logo
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.4 is now available for download.
Servers can now show their own custom logo as the main Large Image in Discord Rich Presence while players are in-game.
Server owners can set their logo using the open.mp/SA-MP server rule: SetServerRule("logo", "https://...") in their gamemode script or config.
Automatic fallback to the Spynixx logo is maintained when unconfigured or while browsing the launcher menu.
Discord activity updates immediately upon connecting to a supported server.
Open the official release page to download and install the latest version.
